Aims to consolidate tools. | Robust, highly functional donor database and CRM with powerful querying, segmentation, and gift processing. - **Fundraising:** Campaigns, appeals, online giving forms

- **Reporting:** Standard and custom reports, dashboards
- **Event Management:** Basic event registration & tracking

- **Data & Reporting:** Extremely powerful query builder, segmentation, custom reports, analytics

- **Event Management:** Simple event registration & tracking
